name: car-rental-brain
description: The real cost of car hire at 120+ airports in Europe, the UK and the US: price per day with a second driver or full cover, deposits held, debit-card acceptance and desk hours, measured from repeated searches and dated - plus a pre-filled live search link. Connects to Car Rental Brain's hosted remote MCP server (https://app.carrentalbrain.com/mcp). Read-only, no account, no sign-in.
